**Explanation** Issue `#5126` requires the direct Anthropic transport to omit an assistant turn with no text and no tool calls. `_format_messages` now skips the exact empty assistant text block produced by `_format_message`. The following user message remains in the request, so the recovery nudge can be sent. The change also covers thinking-only responses because `_parse_response` omits thinking blocks and produces the same empty assistant shape. `TestEmptyAssistantTurn` verifies the user, empty assistant, user sequence and rejects empty text blocks.
